children: Open Text commenced a proposed senior secured notes offering to fund the full redemption of its $1.0 billion 2027 notes and to finance up to $450 million of a tender offer for its 2028 notes.
Commenced proposed offering of senior secured notes under Rule 144A/Reg S, subject to market and customary conditions.
Plans to use net proceeds to redeem $1.0 billion principal of 6.900% Senior Secured Notes due 2027, including premiums and accrued interest.
Also intends to fund all or a portion of a cash tender offer for up to $450 million principal of 3.875% Senior Notes due 2028.
Tender Offer is subject to a Financing Condition tied to proceeds of the proposed offering; company may use cash on hand if condition met or waived.
Tender Offer terms: Expiration Sept 29, 2026 (5:00 p.m. NY), expected settlement Oct 2, 2026; proration may apply if oversubscribed.
